facts.fact: POTRAZ urged organisations to comply with the Cyber and Data Protection Act and to obtain data controller licences, and reported 1,123 licence applications received so far in 2026.
POTRAZ is acting as the enforcing body under the Cyber and Data Protection Act, executing over 100 search and seizure warrants and licensing data controllers.
POTRAZ says 1,123 data controller licence applications were received, 1,218 data protection officers trained and over 100 awareness initiatives held in six provinces, with 60+ breaches reported.
